name: BookStack
description: Self-hosted wiki platform — organize knowledge in shelves, books, chapters, and pages
author: Crow

env_vars.name: BOOKSTACK_TOKEN_ID
env_vars.description: BookStack API token ID (Settings > API Tokens)

env_vars.name: BOOKSTACK_DB_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: MariaDB password (Docker mode). Generated by Crow at install; never shown.

env_vars.name: BOOKSTACK_APP_KEY
env_vars.description: Laravel application key. Generated by Crow at install; never shown.

notes: Crow creates BookStack's admin account (admin@localhost.localdomain) itself at install and saves the password in Settings → Passwords. Self-host via Docker (includes MariaDB) or connect to existing (set BOOKSTACK_URL + API tokens). Create tokens in BookStack under Settings > API Tokens.
